name: expo
description: Official Expo skills for building, deploying, upgrading, and debugging Expo and React Native apps.

shortDescription.en-US: Build, deploy, upgrade, and debug Expo and React Native apps
shortDescription.zh-CN: 构建、部署、升级和调试 Expo 与 React Native 应用

longDescription.en-US: Official Expo-authored skills for building Expo Router UI, authoring API routes, configuring data fetching and styling, writing Expo native modules, adding App Clips, integrating Expo into brownfield native apps, inspecting EAS Update health, creating dev clients, upgrading Expo SDKs, wiring Codex app Run actions, using Expo MCP, and deploying Expo apps with EAS workflows, builds, hosting, TestFlight, App Store, and Play Store guidance.
longDescription.zh-CN: Expo 官方技能，用于构建 Expo Router UI、编写 API routes、配置数据获取和样式、编写 Expo native modules、创建 dev clients、升级 Expo SDK、接入 Codex app Run actions，并通过 EAS workflows、builds、hosting、TestFlight、App Store 和 Play Store 部署 Expo 应用。

defaultPrompt: Build a mobile app with Expo and React Native
Build a tab-based app with Expo Router
Upgrade to the latest Expo SDK and fix breaking changes
Deploy this Expo app with EAS

skillPreviews.name: add-app-clip
skillPreviews.description: Add an iOS App Clip target to an Expo app. Use when the user mentions App Clip, AASA, apple-app-site-association, appclips, smart app banner, or wants to ship a lightweight iOS Clip invoked from a URL alongside their parent app.

skillPreviews.name: building-native-ui
skillPreviews.description: Complete guide for building beautiful apps with Expo Router. Covers fundamentals, styling, components, navigation, animations, patterns, and native tabs.

skillPreviews.name: eas-update-insights
skillPreviews.description: Check the health of published EAS Updates: crash rates, install/launch counts, unique users, payload size, and the split between embedded and OTA users per channel. Use when the user asks how an update is performing, whether a rollout is healthy, how many users are on the embedded build vs OTA, or wants to gate CI on update health.

skillPreviews.name: expo-api-routes
skillPreviews.description: Guidelines for creating API routes in Expo Router with EAS Hosting

skillPreviews.name: expo-brownfield
skillPreviews.description: Integrate Expo and React Native into an existing native iOS or Android app. Use when the user mentions brownfield, embedding React Native in a native app, AAR/XCFramework, or adding Expo to an existing Kotlin/Swift project. Covers both the isolated approach and the integrated approach.

skillPreviews.name: expo-cicd-workflows
skillPreviews.description: Helps understand and write EAS workflow YAML files for Expo projects. Use this skill when the user asks about CI/CD or workflows in an Expo or EAS context, mentions .eas/workflows/, or wants help with EAS build pipelines or deployment automation.

skillPreviews.name: expo-deployment
skillPreviews.description: Deploying Expo apps to iOS App Store, Android Play Store, web hosting, and API routes

skillPreviews.name: expo-dev-client
skillPreviews.description: Build and distribute Expo development clients locally or via TestFlight

skillPreviews.name: expo-examples
skillPreviews.description: Expo's official example projects — the expo/examples repo of ~70 `with-*` integrations (Stripe, Clerk, Supabase, OpenAI, maps, Reanimated, SQLite, Skia, NativeWind, and more). Use when integrating a third-party library or service into an existing Expo app and you want the canonical, version-matched pattern to adapt, or when scaffolding a new project from one with `npx create-expo --example`.

skillPreviews.name: expo-module
skillPreviews.description: Guide for creating and writing Expo native modules and views using the Expo Modules API (Swift, Kotlin, TypeScript). Covers module definition DSL, native views, shared objects, config plugins, lifecycle hooks, autolinking, and type system. Use when building or modifying native modules for Expo.

skillPreviews.name: expo-observe
skillPreviews.description: Use for anything related to EAS Observe — adding `expo-observe` to an Expo project (AppMetricsRoot/ObserveRoot HOC, markInteractive, the useObserve hook, and the Expo Router / React Navigation integrations for per-route metrics), querying via the EAS CLI (`eas observe:metrics-summary`, `observe:metrics`, `observe:routes`, `observe:events`, `observe:versions`), or interpreting the resulting metrics (cold/warm launch, TTR, TTI, navigation cold/warm TTR, update download, and the TTI frameRate params for triaging slow startups).

skillPreviews.name: expo-tailwind-setup
skillPreviews.description: Set up Tailwind CSS v4 in Expo with react-native-css and NativeWind v5 for universal styling

skillPreviews.name: expo-ui
skillPreviews.description: Build native UI with the @expo/ui package: real SwiftUI on iOS and Jetpack Compose on Android rendered from React in an Expo or React Native app. Covers universal cross-platform components (Host, Column, Row, Button, Text, List, and more imported from @expo/ui), drop-in replacements for popular React Native community libraries (BottomSheet, DateTimePicker, Slider, Menu, etc.), and platform-specific SwiftUI (@expo/ui/swift-ui) and Jetpack Compose (@expo/ui/jetpack-compose) trees and modifiers. Use when adding or reviewing @expo/ui Host/RNHostView trees, building native-feeling UI where standard React Native components fall short (lists with swipe actions and sections, settings forms with toggles, menus, sheets, pickers, sliders), choosing between universal and platform-specific components, or replacing an RN community UI library with a native @expo/ui equivalent. Not for custom native modules, Expo Router navigation, Reanimated, or data fetching.

skillPreviews.name: native-data-fetching
skillPreviews.description: Use when implementing or debugging ANY network request, API call, or data fetching. Covers fetch API, React Query, SWR, error handling, caching, offline support, and Expo Router data loaders (`useLoaderData`).

skillPreviews.name: upgrading-expo
skillPreviews.description: Guidelines for upgrading Expo SDK versions and fixing dependency issues

skillPreviews.name: use-dom
skillPreviews.description: Use Expo DOM components to run web code in a webview on native and as-is on web. Migrate web code to native incrementally.
